articles.title: Bitcoin options remain expensive despite summer calm. Here's why it matters
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s implied volatility is near a seasonal floor, but options continue to price substantially more movement than the market is delivering.

articles.title: Crypto investors are looking past market-cap rankings and back to fundamentals
articles.snippet: Investors are starting to judge crypto tokens on usage, economics and value capture rather than market-cap rank, industry executives said.

articles.title: MiCA's cleanup is creating a new scam wave across the European Union
articles.snippet: Fraudsters impersonating regulators and licensed crypto exchanges to steal funds from users forced to migrate their accounts after the EU's MiCA deadline are on the rise.

articles.title: White House Lets Private Firms Hack Cybercriminals—At Their Own Legal Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed a memorandum Tuesday that lets vetted U.S. companies carry out offensive cyber operations against foreign criminal networks. Here's what the program actually authorizes.
